facts.fact: Cybernetica says that in 2014 it and the e-Governance Academy introduced an interoperability platform, known locally as Nam-X, connecting databases of different entities, and that Namibia has implemented it for secure data exchange between organisations.

Cybernetica says an ESTDEV-funded project begun in 2024 continues scaling the Nam-X platform, developing two digital services for it, and was expected to end in March 2025; no count of connected bodies is given.

systems.owner: Office of the Prime Minister, Department of Public Service e-Government Management
